digest.component_or_area: MCP server infrastructure and Jira bridge integration
propositions: AWS SSM parameters for Jira credentials (url, user, api-token) were operator-seeded out-of-band but lack terraform wiring, causing bridge_check_access to fail with missing credentials error.
JIRA_PROJECT environment variable is required by access_check._resolve_probe_scope but not provided, causing probe to fail with missing_project reason even if other credentials are present.

Credentials must be read softly (optional, non-aborting) and passed to mcp container via .env file only, never as -e flags, to preserve compose/.mcp_run_new parity and prevent soft-degrade failures from blocking unrelated deploys.

Terraform must adopt three operator-seeded SSM parameters via import blocks to avoid ParameterAlreadyExists collision on apply, while honoring the type split (String for url/user/project, SecureString for api-token).

Four Jira environment variables must reach both compose and blue-green docker run paths via _ENV_FILE_ONLY mechanism and .env file, with JIRA_PROJECT fully terraform-managed and pinned equal to rebar.toml value.
